mapper.select: SELECT n_root.id AS node_id, n_root.node_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.enterprise_id) AS enterprise_count FROM chain_node n_root LEFT JOIN chain_node n ON n.chain_id = n_root.chain_id AND n.node_path LIKE CONCAT(n_root.node_path, '%') AND n.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN enterprise_node_rel r ON r.node_id = n.id AND r.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN enterprise e ON e.id = r.enterprise_id AND e.is_deleted = 0 WHERE n_root.parent_id IS NULL AND n_root.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY n_root.id, n_root.node_name ORDER BY n_root.chain_id, n_root.sort_order, n_root.id
